title: The Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 (Commencement No. 15 and Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2026
The Contracts for Difference (Allocation) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Contracts for Difference (Allocation) Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/2011) (“Allocation Regulations”). The Allocation Regulations form part of the legislative framework underpinning the Contracts for Difference scheme under Chapter 2 of Part 2 of the Energy Act 2013. These Regulations concern the arrangements for determining whether renewables projects qualify for a Contract for Difference and the procedure where qualification appeals are pending when the process of allocating contracts begins.

title: The Marine Licensing (Miscellaneous Provisions) (Amendment etc.) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009 (c. 23) (“the 2009 Act”), the Marine Licensing (Exempted Activities) Order 2011 (S.I. 2011/409) (“the 2011 Order”), and the Marine Licensing (Register of Licensing Information) Regulations 2011 (S.I. 2011/424) (“the 2011 Regulations”).

title: The Energy Prices Act 2022 (Amendment) (Northern Ireland) Regulations 2026
summary:
Paragraph 7
(1)
(a) of 
Schedule 5 to the 
Energy Prices Act 2022 (c. 44) provides that certain powers in 
that Act may only be exercised in the first period of 26 months to end after 
that Act was passed during the whole of which both the First Minister and deputy First Minister in Northern Ireland have held office.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Elstow, Bedfordshire) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
The Public Service Pension Schemes (Rectification of Unlawful Discrimination) (Tax) Regulations 2026
summary: In this Explanatory Note, references to “FA” followed by a year are to a Finance Act of that year, references to “HMRC” are to the Commissioners for His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs, references to “ITEPA 2003” are to the Income Tax (Earnings and Pensions) Act 2003 (c. 1) and references to “PSPJOA 2022” are to the Public Service Pensions and Judicial Offices Act 2022 (c. 7).

title: The Registration of Births, Deaths, Marriages and Civil Partnerships (Fees) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend Schedule 1 to the Registration of Births, Deaths, Marriages and Civil Partnerships (Fees) Regulations 2016 (“the Fees Regulations”), which set fees for applications and services in relation to the registration of births, deaths, marriages and civil partnerships in England and Wales.

title: The Registered Pension Schemes (Net Pay Arrangements) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend section 193A of the Finance Act 2004 (c. 12). Section 193A requires the Commissioners for His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs (HMRC) to make top-up payments directly to individuals who save into an occupational pension scheme under net pay arrangements, in order to reduce disparities with occupational pension schemes administered under relief at source arrangements.

title: The Pension Schemes Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2026
summary: These are the first commencement regulations made under the Pension Schemes Act 2026 (c. 22) (“the Act”).

title: The Public Sector Fraud and Error (Recovery) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in relation to direct deduction orders (“DDOs”) under section 17 of the Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 (c. 28) (“the Act”) and deduction from earnings orders (“DEOs”) under section 39 of the Act.

title: The Sunnica Energy Farm (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Sunnica Energy Farm Order 2024, a development consent order under the Planning Act 2008, following an application made in accordance with the Infrastructure Planning (Changes to, and Revocation of, Development Consent Orders) Regulations 2011 for a non-material amendment under paragraph 2 of Schedule 6 to the Planning Act 2008. This Order amends Schedule 10 of the 2024 Order relating to certified documents.

summary: The Court and Tribunal Fees (Miscellaneous Amendments) Order 2026 (S.I. 2026/642) (“the 2026 Fees Order”) amends the following instruments relating to court and tribunal fees—

title: The Prison (Governor’s and Adjudicators’ Punishments) (Amendment) Rules 2026
summary: These Rules amend the Prison Rules 1999 (S.I. 1999/728) by extending the punishments available to a governor and to an adjudicator following a finding of guilt for an offence against discipline listed in Prison Rule 51.

title: The Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations restate, revoke and replace assimilated law relating to animals used in scientific research, maintaining the current legislative framework by consolidating the provisions into the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 (c. 14) (“the ASPA”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Sywell) Regulations 2026
The Wireless Telegraphy (Direct to Device Satellite Communications) (Exemption) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Wireless Telegraphy (Direct to Device Satellite Communications) (Exemption) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/139) (“the Principal Regulations”) to extend the circumstances in which wireless telegraphy apparatus (including mobile phones) which are established, installed or used for direct to device services will be exempt from the requirement to be licensed under section 8(1) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 (c. 36).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Birkdale, Merseyside) Regulations 2026
The Airports Slot Allocation (Alleviation of Usage Requirements) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made in exercise of the power in section 14(3) of the Retained EU Law (Revocation and Reform) Act 2023 (c. 28) (“the 2023 Act”). These Regulations amend Council Regulation (EEC) No 95/93 of 18 January 1993 on common rules for the allocation of slots at United Kingdom airports (“the Slot Regulation”) to make provision about the calculation of airport slot usage for the 2026 summer and winter scheduling periods.

title: The English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1 and Saving) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the first commencement regulations under the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (c. 23).
